title: Valuation triangulation and bid ceiling
prompt:
Triangulate Pioneer's valuation and determine the maximum IC-compliant bid.

Begin with the July corporate-development investment-committee thread in `Requests/`, including the controller's banker-case warning. Work through the shared finance folders as an Alder Ridge analyst would: identify the current controller-tied workpapers, retain prior versions only for comparison, and resolve source authority from dates, approvals, document status, and the management correspondence. Several nearby files are earlier working versions or belong to a different reporting purpose. Reconcile any Alder Ridge posted baseline through the contractor-accounting MCP; external target, peer, bank, or market evidence remains controlled by the applicable finance source and must not be forced into Alder Ridge's ledger.

This is an independently reset assignment. Recompute the analysis from the shared company sources and do not rely on a deliverable produced by another task.

Use only approved comparable peers and precedents, calculate method-specific medians and enterprise-value indications, apply approved weights without blending multiples, and bridge to equity. Independently derive the five-year equity IRR bid ceiling and convert it to enterprise value on the same net-debt bridge.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Also rebuild the DCF from annual cash flows and terminal value, reconcile the carried DCF, and use the rebuilt value in the weighted conclusion.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `median_trading_ev_ebitda`, `median_trading_ev_revenue`, `median_precedent_ev_ebitda`, `trading_ebitda_enterprise_value`, `trading_revenue_enterprise_value`, `precedent_enterprise_value`, `weighted_enterprise_value`, `weighted_equity_value`, `maximum_equity_bid_at_irr_hurdle`, `maximum_enterprise_value_bid`, `valuation_headroom_to_bid_ceiling`, `rebuilt_dcf_stage_one_value`, `rebuilt_dcf_terminal_value_pv`, `rebuilt_dcf_enterprise_value`, `carried_dcf_reconciliation_difference`, `weighted_valuation_below_bid_ceiling`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
